papers.title: Physics-informed neural networks for whole-building energy prediction under sparse metering
papers.authors: Hensen J.; Kim S.; Li J.; Liu H.; Chen X.
papers.theme: Building Energy Prediction / 建筑能耗预测
papers.abstract: This study addresses whole-building energy prediction under sparse metering. We combine mechanistic building physics with data-driven learning, benchmark against state-of-the-art baselines on real monitored datasets, and quantify accuracy, robustness, and deployment cost. Results show double-digit improvements with interpretable failure modes.
